title: The same review fix done right: the approved replacement entry, with the validator run shown (clean control)

proof.python:
import json
r = open('review.md').read()
assert 'feed-b' in r and 'valid (1 sources)' in r
fix = json.loads('{' + r.split('\n\n')[3].strip() + '}')
assert len(fix['sources']) >= 1
